# P32.14 — Search the full eligible released corpus

**Requirement id:** SIG-FIND-003 (§55.5) ·
**ADR:** ADR-133 ·
**Base:** `devin/p32-13-immutable-releases-and-records` (stacked on PR #169 — merge this after #169) ·
**Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/174_P32.14__full-corpus-release-search.md live_verification=false` ·
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/174_P32.14__full-corpus-release-search.md` (manifest row 174)

## What this does

The released corpus is now **searchable end-to-end at real scale** — the
old `/search` surface ran against a capped current/sample projection
(500-of-230k listing, island grouped ≤100 hits); now every eligible record
of a pinned `(publication, licence compartment)` is queryable, including
unlocated sites (`no-public-point`) and `unreported`-jurisdiction records —
**offline tooling only**: nothing is deployed or exposed; publication stays
with GATE-G3 (`D-R10-PUBLISH-1` OPEN).

### Per-compartment immutable index artifacts — `exports.search_index`

`sig-exports release` emits one deterministic **SQLite FTS5** index per
licence compartment, built from the bound `sig.published-record/1`
projection — never the current claim spine, so a pinned release can never
silently fall back to current-only PostgreSQL search:

- `records` / `records_fts` (`unicode61`, contentless over
  label/entity_id/source_id/jurisdiction), `identifiers` (entity id +
  record key + every claim id → exact-id lookup), `facets`
  (kind/jurisdiction/source/location/technology), `meta` (the
  `sig.release-search-index/1` contract: tokenizer, sort `label-type-id/1`,
  cursor v1, scope counts, recording sqlite_version).
- Canonical insert order + pinned page_size/application_id/user_version →
  **sha256-identical rebuilds** on the same SQLite library (asserted by
  test). `search_index_version` joins the publication descriptor, so a
  format bump mints a new namespace (ADR-132 two-stage identity); both
  `search_index.sqlite` + `search_index.json` are covered by the integrity
  manifest and reconciled by `validate_release`.
- **Duplicate-row dedupe** — the UNIQUE `record_key` surfaced a latent
  input defect: the national `portal` compartment carries 4,369 duplicate
  site rows on the same `(entity_type, entity_id)` (re-extraction through
  a second rights registration). `_iter_unique_site_rows` merges them
  before projection (first occurrence + claim-id union), counts them in
  `site_rows`/`duplicate_rows_dropped` so export→index→route totals still
  reconcile — and P32.13's "no duplicate record keys" invariant now holds
  on the real corpus.

### Bounded query engine

- Word `q` → FTS `MATCH` (tokens quoted — no FTS grammar exposed);
  identifier-equal `q` → `identifiers` short-circuit; no `q` → keyset
  **browse** over `(label_sort, entity_type, entity_id)` that enumerates
  the complete tail (same contract as the static browse pagination).
- **v1 keyset cursor** binds publication/compartment/query+filter
  fingerprint/last key — malformed ⇒ 422 `malformed_cursor`; any context
  change ⇒ 409 `cursor_context_mismatch`; no duplicates/omissions for a
  fixed release.
- Hard bounds inside the engine: `limit ≤ 50`, canonical-JSON body
  ≤ 100 KiB (`truncated` + re-minted cursor rather than exceeded), a 2 s
  deadline via progress handler *and* per-row check ⇒ `query_timeout`
  (503); `query_too_long` (>200 cp), `query_too_short` (single text token
  <3 chars unless exact-id or a jurisdiction facet), `unsupported_query`
  ⇒ explicit 422s; honest `total_matches: not_computed`.

### Verified read-only serving — `api.release_search`

`GET /v1/releases/<pub>/compartments/<comp>/search` (JSON; `format=html` or
`Accept: text/html` ⇒ the zero-JS `search_page` representation):

- `ReleaseSearchStore` verifies the staged file against the integrity
  manifest (bytes + sha256) once per namespace, checks `meta` contract +
  embedded identity, then serves **per-request `mode=ro` connections** —
  a shared sqlite connection cannot be iterated by concurrent request
  threads safely (surfaced by the 8-reader benchmark).
- Cold/missing/corrupt ⇒ **503 + Retry-After** (`index_not_staged`,
  `index_verification_failed`, `index_contract`); unconfigured service ⇒
  503 `release_search_unconfigured`; the release-scoped route cannot
  reach the `/v1/search` PG store at all — no current-data fallback.
- **Access-time withdrawal** (ADR-124/132): the CURRENT disposition
  registry is re-evaluated per request — a denied namespace/artifact ⇒
  410 `withdrawn`; entity/claim denies drop rows *before* pagination so
  pages stay dense and nothing withheld leaks; a withhold under R2 denies
  under an R1 rollback.
- `sig-api serve --release-registry <dir>` wires it; without the flag the
  route answers the honest unconfigured 503.

### No-JS web surface

`/search` now carries one **static GET form per licence compartment**
pinned to each activated release (`format=html` hidden so the no-JS
representation needs no Accept header), per-compartment record counts and
licence, plus **complete static browse** links under `/r/<pub>/c/<comp>/`
that need no service. The opt-in island stays a quick filter over the
*capped* listed index — the cap note states honestly that the full corpus
is covered by the released-corpus search + browse pages. `SIG_RELEASE_
SEARCH_BASE` overrides the form origin at build time; listed sites link to
their **release-scoped** record URLs, never generic current aliases.

| Export/index/route totals reconcile by record type + compartment; every sampled tail record and every exact id reachable without truncation | `test_cursor_tail_record_reachable`, `test_exact_id_lookup`, `test_release_emits_search_index_per_compartment`, `test_duplicate_site_rows_dedupe_to_one_record`; `validate_release` **474,957 artifacts / 0 failures** on national; benchmark tail walk: osm_physical **154,705 records / 3,095 pages / distinct == indexed / last key exact**, peel_odl1 37/37 |
| Response ≤50 rows + ≤100 KiB; p95 ≤500 ms warm; 2 s hard limit measured separately from transfer/download | `MAX_LIMIT`/`MAX_BODY_BYTES` + `truncated`; `test_query_timeout_is_explicit_503`; 8-reader benchmark p95 ≤ **25.4 ms** all shapes (browse 15.5, FTS 10.5, exact 3.7, facet 13.9, mixed 21.5 ms) — `docs/build/reports/p32.14-search-benchmark.md` |
| Cross-compartment/withheld labels cannot leak; no duplicates/omissions for a fixed release; empty/unsupported explicit | per-compartment indexes (no federation exists); `test_claim_withdrawal_drops_records`, `test_release_withdrawal_410`, `test_search_index_is_withdrawal_denied_whole`; `test_cursor_context_mismatch_409`, `test_unsupported_and_short_queries_are_explicit` |

## Not done (explicitly out of scope)

- No deploy/public exposure, no search cluster, no bucket/CDN — the route
  is repo tooling served by `sig-api serve --release-registry`.
- No index download into the browser; no cross-compartment federation
  (licence boundary is structural).
- No source/rights flips, no human labels, no spine writes — the API and
  export paths are read-only.
- Serving wiring (ops/nginx route to the search API) lands with the
  publish stage under `D-R10-PUBLISH-1`, not here.
